alias: Master Bedroom Echo - Stricter Wake Word During Sleep Sounds
description: Sleep Sounds play from the Echo's own speaker and can set off its wake word. While input_boolean.bedroom_night_mode is on, the Kiosk Satellite wake word is set to Slightly sensitive; when it turns off, back to Moderately sensitive (the kitchen's setting). Was VACA's numeric threshold 9.5 until 2026-11-21.
